newsitem.title: UK: KBC Advanced Technologies announces float.
newsitem.headline: KBC Advanced Technologies announces float.

text.p: KBC Advanced Technologies Limited (KBC) said on Thursday it intended to float on the London Stock Exchange in mid-March.
KBC said it planned to raise 25.0 million stg with an institutional placing valuing it at 80.0 million stg.
KBC provides consultancy and support services to oil refiners with a view to improved profitability and operational efficiency. Its main product is marketed as the Profit Improvement Program.
"This is a very exciting time for KBC," said Richard Davies, chairman.

"The listing will provide us with more flexible funding opportunities to develop the business through acquisition and will further raise our profile in the international markets we serve," Davies said.
Cazenove & Co is acting for KBC in connection with the placing and first dealings in the shares are scheduled for March 20.
